title: Zombie Kidz Evolution
subtitle: The first cooperative legacy game for kids and families defending their school from a playful zombie invasion
tagline: Lock the four gates, crack open mystery envelopes, and evolve your school defense squad!
loreSummary: Zombies have invaded your school and are swarming through the classrooms! Team up with your classmates, coordinate your movements to eliminate intruders, and padlock all four outside gates before the building is overrun. As you play, place brain stickers on your progress passport and crack open 13 sealed mystery envelopes that permanently mutate rules, grant hero superpowers, and transform the adventure.
keyFeatures: First true legacy board game engineered specifically for kids, families, and cooperative groups
Progressive envelope system with 13 sealed packets adding new rules, powers, and mutations
Rewarding sticker passport that progresses after every game whether you win or lose
Fast 15-minute tactical gameplay with escalating challenge and tactical cooperation

zombiekidz_quick_arc.name: School Defense Quick Arc
zombiekidz_quick_arc.description: An introductory 8-game sprint opening the initial mystery envelopes and establishing basic schoolyard perimeter defense coordination.

zombiekidz_standard.name: Standard Evolution Campaign
zombiekidz_standard.description: The complete standard 15-game arc unlocking the core rules, hero superpowers, mutant zombie breeds, and securing all school gates.

zombiekidz_completionist.name: Ultimate Trophy & Sticker Completionist
zombiekidz_completionist.description: A full 25-game achievement run tackling all special mission challenges, opening all 13 sealed envelopes, and earning the Master Hunter rank.

milestones.title: First Sealed Mystery Envelope
milestones.description: Mark the evolution track with brain stickers, break the seal on Envelope 1, and introduce the first campaign rule mutations.

milestones.title: Zombie Mutation Surge
milestones.description: Special mutant zombies breach the hallway perimeters with new tactical movement rules and challenging behaviors.

milestones.title: Hero Superpowers Unlocked
milestones.description: Unseal hero capability envelopes, bestowing each kid defender with unique superpowers and upgraded abilities.

milestones.title: School Gates Total Lockdown
milestones.description: Master coordinate movements to padlock all four outer portals before the zombie reserve runs dry.

milestones.title: Grand Evolution Master
milestones.description: Crack open the final mystery envelopes, unlock the legendary badges, and complete the ultimate school evolution.
